en.title: Resume

points: Coursework: Marketing Management, Economics and Business Mathematics, Business Statistics, Organizational Behaviour, International Business, Business Communication, Operations Management.

New-product research and communication: Supported early research for ZUS Coffee products using audience preferences, social feedback and competitor content to define product messages and communication themes.
Social content execution: Supported 50 Instagram posts through planning, photography, editing, English copy, hashtags and asset organization.

Channel coordination and review: Supported online launches and FamilyMart communication with promotional assets, store information and schedules. Tracked data weekly and completed 15+ content reviews; contributed to 11k+ account follower growth.

University project coordination: Coordinated university talks and product trials, aligned demos, FAQs, teacher cases and course materials with product and business teams, and supported on-site organization and questions. Turned user behaviour and feedback into 10 improvement suggestions for product updates and future pilots.

Market needs: Managed the user community and classified 100+ feedback items across teaching, lesson preparation and self-study scenarios in mainland China and overseas. Identified recurring needs and barriers to inform communication and event adjustments.

Product materials: Built the product WeChat account from scratch and produced 30+ guides, tutorials, FAQs and use cases. Organized reusable promotional materials; core-feature usage increased 30% during the period.
Partnership follow-up: Supported Southeast Asia AI education cooperation by clarifying needs and responsibilities and following up on agreement signing and handoff.
Coursework: Marketing Analytics, Consumer Behaviour, Marketing Research, Customer Analytics and CRM, B2B Marketing, New Product Marketing.

Needs research and market planning: Used feedback and pricing surveys to understand functional needs and price acceptance, then shaped product messages and communication by user stage. Designed selected acquisition campaigns and supported preparation, product introductions and execution at technology events.
AI-assisted analysis: Created a lightweight operations dashboard with AI assistance to track core metrics and locate drop-off points in the user journey.

Promotional materials and resources: Produced 100+ product introductions, use cases and FAQs across WeChat, Xiaohongshu and communities. Screened creators by audience fit, content and engagement, and supported asset preparation, launch tracking and copy/visual review.

Performance and budget: Campaign-period registrations grew 50% versus the previous week, while first-topic creation rate increased approximately 15% relatively. Supported channel budget optimization through title, cover and content A/B tests.

skills: Master of Marketing candidate graduating in 2027, with working English and experience in needs research, promotion planning, partner communication and event execution.
Market support: pricing surveys, needs synthesis, product messages, promotional plans and materials, event organization.
AI: dashboard creation, data analysis, copy and content ideas; SOPs, checklists and reusable templates.
Data: Excel, SPSS, SQL (basic); channel tracking and review to inform campaign adjustments.
Materials: Canva, CapCut, Figma (basic); WeChat, Xiaohongshu and Instagram content production and publishing.
Coordination: partner needs, internal teams, event preparation and questions; task tracking with Feishu, DingTalk and Linear.
